name: 云梦县底图边界基线
status: working-baseline; not an official surveyed boundary
coordinateConvention: WGS84-like, existing approximate GCJ-02 inverse transform per repository license notes

topologyRepair.method: unary_union, no smoothing or coordinate relocation

planningComparisons.method: Brown outer county-line connected component; fill and 2px erosion; robust affine silhouette fit. This is visual shape comparison, not surveyed georeferencing.
Brown outer county-line connected component; fill and 2px erosion; robust affine silhouette fit. This is visual shape comparison, not surveyed georeferencing.

limitations: Reference screenshots identify the overall county outline but do not provide an authoritative coordinate grid.
Existing county coordinates are generalized and approximately inverse-transformed from GCJ-02.

A separately checked DataV single-county source has 520 original vertices and differs from the current footprint by about 1.56 km2 symmetric difference; it has not been substituted into shared county boundaries.
Statistical area is not used to scale or reshape the boundary.
